Find Eren and Mikasa near the outer gate

complete.deed: Spent the last quiet morning of 845 with Eren, Mikasa and Armin

steps.objective: Walk home along the main street

say.text: A bolt of lightning from a clear sky. A hand of bare muscle grips the top of the Wall.

steps.objective: Look toward the outer gate

say.text: The gate bursts inward. Boulders rain across the district.

steps.objective: Run to Eren's house — Carla is trapped
Help Carla
A titan is coming down the street — cut it down!

say.text: A titan with a fixed, smiling face lumbers toward the house.
I can't — kid, if you've got blades, now's the time!

steps.objective: Get to the evacuation boats at the inner gate

say.text: Behind you, the house falls quiet.

steps.objective: Find Armin at the boats

Speak to the girl sitting alone

Take a loaf from the crate without anyone seeing you (crouch, stay out of their sight)

done.deed: Stole bread for a starving refugee girl

say.text: You're amazing...

steps.objective: Your father is arguing with a man in a Military Police coat
A Garrison courier is reading out names — find your father

say.text: A Garrison courier rides through with a list of names.

steps.objective: Walk him to the edge of the village

say.text: Of the two hundred and fifty thousand, about a hundred came back. He was not one of them.

say.text: Ha! Told you it'd fly.

Slip past the guard while his back is turned

complete.deed: Saw the sky for the first time in years

Find Sasha after sundown
Put on your ODM harness for the aptitude test

Annie is training alone by the fence
Reiner and Bertholdt are by the barracks
Head out to the training forest
Cut the napes of the training titans

say.text: Race you, {first}! Most napes gets the top spot!

Graduation day — fall in

Talk to Eren
Brace yourself!

The outer gate explodes inward. Boulders hammer the district.

THOMAS!
It's got Thomas!

say.text: {first}? I'm fine. Reiner, Annie and Bertholdt were just here. They were acting... strange.

success.deed: Found Marco alive — and three friends acting strangely

missions.title: I Thought the Enemy Was Titans

steps.objective: The Survey Corps is recruiting in the square

card.title: ACT I — THE WALLS
card.sub: I thought the enemy was titans.

a.speaker: armin_child
a.text: Oh — {first}. You didn't see that, did you? They say wanting to go outside the Walls is heresy.

b.speaker: armin_child
b.text: Look — Grandpa's book. Beyond the Walls there's water that burns, plains of ice, and a sea of salt so wide no merchant could ever buy it all.

choices.text: The outside? That's heresy, Armin. The Walls keep us alive.
A sea of salt... I want to see it too.
Who hit you? I'll go and have a word with them.

c1.speaker: armin_child
c1.text: ...Maybe. But a hundred years is a long time to live in a birdcage.

c2.speaker: armin_child
c2.text: Really? Then let's go together someday — you, me, Eren and Mikasa!

c3.speaker: armin_child
c3.text: Eren already chased them off. And then Mikasa chased them off harder.

a.speaker: hannes
a.text: Ha! Look who it is. Don't look at me like that, kid. If the Wall ever gets kicked in, we'll do our jobs. It's been a hundred years.

b.speaker: eren_child
b.text: A hundred years of drinking! You're Garrison. You're supposed to be ready!

c.speaker: eren_child
c.text: {first}, tell him. People who never leave the Walls are just livestock.

choices.text: Eren's right. We're cattle in a pen.
Leave him be, Eren. Peace isn't a crime.
Mr. Hannes — what would you do if it really broke?

d2.speaker: hannes
d2.text: Ha! At least one of you has sense. Go on home before Carla skins you both.

d3.speaker: hannes
d3.text: ...Run to the boats, kid. Don't look back. That's what I'd tell you. Now scram.

a.speaker: carla
a.text: Eren! Mikasa! {first} — take them and RUN!

b.speaker: eren_child
b.text: No! We can lift it — Mom, give me your hand!

choices.text: Pull at the beam with Eren.
Carla's right. Grab Mikasa and go!
I'll find a soldier!

c1.text: The beam won't move. The ground shakes with footsteps.

c3.text: You run into the street and straight into Hannes.

d.speaker: hannes
d.text: Carla! I've got this — kids, get back!

e.speaker: carla
e.text: Hannes, take the children. Please. ...Eren. Mikasa. You have to live.

a.speaker: armin_child
a.text: {first}! Eren! Mikasa! Where's — where's your mother?

b.speaker: eren_child
b.text: I'll kill them. Every last one of them. I'll wipe them off the face of this earth!

choices.text: I'll be there beside you, Eren.
Hate won't bring her back.
(Say nothing. Hold Mikasa's hand.)

c.text: The boats pull away from the burning district. Behind the gate, Wall Maria has fallen.

a.speaker: armin_child
a.text: Grandpa's been called up. The government's sending two hundred and fifty thousand refugees to 'retake' Wall Maria.

b.speaker: armin_child
b.text: No one expects them back. There isn't enough food for all of us, so...

choices.text: They're sending the hungry to die so the rest can eat.
Someone has to try to take the land back.
Then we become strong enough that no one else is sent to die.

c.speaker: eren_child
c.text: We're joining the Cadet Corps. All three of us. {first} — you're coming too, aren't you?

choices.text: Of course.
I'll join. But for my own reasons.

a.speaker: garrison_captain
a.text: Stand back, civilian! Wall Maria has fallen. Shiganshina is gone. These people have nothing.

b.speaker: garrison_captain
b.text: Make yourself useful or get out of the way.

choices.text: I'll help carry the wounded.
Keep the crowd back? I can do that.
How does a Wall that stood a hundred years just... fall?

c1.speaker: garrison_captain
c1.text: Good. The girl over there lost her whole family. Start with her.

c2.speaker: garrison_captain
c2.text: Hm. Maybe you're Garrison material. Watch that girl — she's been sitting there for an hour.

c3.speaker: garrison_captain
c3.text: A titan fifty meters tall. That's all anyone saw. Now move!

a.speaker: lotte
a.text: ...Are there titans here too?

choices.text: Not here. The Walls are strong. You're safe.
I don't know. But I'll look out for you.
Where are your parents?

b.speaker: lotte
b.text: My name's Lotte. I'm going to remember you.

c.speaker: lotte
c.text: Mama pushed me onto the boat. She said she'd be on the next one.

a.speaker: baker
a.text: Bread's five times what it was last week. Blame the refugees — every mouth from Maria is another mouth here.

b.speaker: lotte
b.text: {first}... I haven't eaten since the boat.

choices.text: Buy her a loaf. [10 Marks]

effects.deed: Bought bread for a starving refugee

choices.text: (Whisper) I'll get you some. Wait here.
Rules are rules. Wait for the ration line.

a.speaker: aldo
a.text: The Military Police want a third of the harvest. For the refugees, they say.

b.speaker: tax_collector
b.text: By order of the Crown: grain for Wall Rose's refugees. Or would your family rather explain to the King why it hoards?

choices.text: Take it. People are starving.
A third? Half this village will starve by winter.
Perhaps the Crown's granaries in Mitras could spare some first?

c2.speaker: tax_collector
c2.text: Careful, farmer's child. Words like that get people remembered.

c3.speaker: tax_collector
c3.text: ...A quarter, then. And I'll remember your face.

a.speaker: aldo
a.text: They've drafted me. The Wall Maria Reclamation Operation. Two hundred and fifty thousand of us.

b.speaker: aldo
b.text: Farmers with pikes against titans. They don't mean for us to come back. They mean to have fewer mouths.

choices.text: Then don't go. I'll hide you in the barn.
Why are we sacrificing thousands to protect these walls?
Come back, Father. Promise me.

c1.speaker: aldo
c1.text: And have them burn the farm and take you instead? No. Listen to me.

c2.speaker: aldo
c2.text: Because the people in the middle need someone between them and the titans. That's always been us.

d.speaker: aldo
d.text: Join the military. Not to hide behind a wall — go where the decisions are made, and make better ones.

effects.deed: Watched your father march to the Reclamation, 846

a.speaker: hilde
a.text: Please — I paid the permit last month—

b.speaker: mp_officer
b.text: And this month the permit costs more. The refugees need feeding, you see. So do I.

choices.text: Leave her alone. That's theft in a uniform.
Here — take this, and let her be. [20 Marks]
Nothing, officer.
Do you know who my family is?

d1.speaker: mp_officer
d1.text: Brave. Brave people go missing in Stohess all the time.

a.speaker: priest
a.text: The Walls are the work of God. To question them is to spit on the hand that shields you.

choices.text: What are the Walls made of, Pastor?
Praise the Walls.
Then why did one of them break?

b1.speaker: priest
b1.text: ...That is not for us to know. Some truths are only safe in the dark.

b3.speaker: priest
b3.text: God tested the faithless of Maria. Do not be among them.

a.speaker: steward
a.text: My lord takes an interest in promising young people. Graduate in the top ten of the Cadet Corps and there's a place for you in the Military Police. The interior. Safety. Comfort.

choices.text: I'll do it.
And if I want to see what's outside?

b.speaker: steward
b.text: Then you'll see it from the inside of a titan. Good day.

a.speaker: ferrin
a.text: You want out of this hole, you need wings. The MP keep a gear pack at the guard post by the market. Old model, but it flies.

b.speaker: ferrin
b.text: Walk in, take it, walk out. Don't let the guards see you. And don't let them see a blade in your hand.

choices.text: And what's your cut?
Stealing from the Military Police? Count me in.
There has to be another way up.

c1.speaker: ferrin
c1.text: Half of whatever it's worth to you. Go on.

c3.speaker: ferrin
c3.text: Sure. Pay the stairway toll like a good citizen. It's only three months' wages.

a.speaker: stair_guard
a.text: Stairway to the surface. Toll's three hundred Marks. No toll, no daylight.

choices.text: Pay the toll. [300 Marks]
I'm expected at the Cadet Corps. Want to explain to Instructor Shadis why I'm late?
(Show him the gear pack — then fly straight past him.)
(Walk away — and wait for his back to turn.)

a.speaker: keith
a.text: YOU! WHO ARE YOU?! WHERE ARE YOU FROM?! WHY ARE YOU HERE?!

choices.text: {name}, sir! From Shiganshina! I'm here to kill every titan alive!
{name}, sir! Trost! To protect the people inside the Walls!
{name}, sir! Ragako! To change how this army spends its people!
{name}, sir! {origin}! To earn a place in the Military Police!
{name}, sir! From the Underground! To see the sky and never go back!
{name}, sir! To find out what's really out there!

b.speaker: keith
b.text: Hmph. We'll see if you're still standing in three years.

c.text: Down the line, a girl bites into a stolen potato in front of the entire corps.

d.speaker: keith
d.text: ...YOU! What do you think you're doing?!

e.speaker: sasha
e.text: It was going to go to waste, sir! So I — here. Half?

a.speaker: sasha
a.text: {first}! You didn't laugh when he made me run till sundown. Here — the other half of the potato. I'm Sasha. Sasha Braus, from Dauper.

choices.text: Eat it. You earned it running laps.
I'll take it.

b.speaker: sasha
b.text: Hehe. Friends, then!

a.speaker: eren
a.text: I can't stay upright on the rigs. If I fail this, they send me home. I can't go home. There IS no home.

choices.text: Let me look at your belt... the buckle's cracked.

effects.deed: Found the broken belt that almost sent Eren home

choices.text: Try again. Tighten your core, lean forward.
Maybe you're not cut out for this.

b1.speaker: eren
b1.text: It — it IS broken! {first}, you're a lifesaver!

b3.speaker: eren
b3.text: Say that again when I'm in the Survey Corps.

a.speaker: annie
a.text: Hand-to-hand. They don't score it, so nobody takes it seriously. You want to learn, or just watch?

choices.text: Teach me.
Why bother, if it isn't scored?

b1.speaker: annie
b1.text: Feet here. Your weight goes through the hip, not the arm. ...Again.

b2.speaker: annie
b2.text: Because my father said so. And because the whole world is against us, so you'd better be able to stand on your own.

a.speaker: reiner
a.text: {first}, right? Good work on the rigs. Where'd you say you were from?

b.speaker: bertholdt
b.text: Reiner and I are from a mountain village... in Wall Maria. It's... not there anymore.

choices.text: Like the Shiganshina kids, then. I'm sorry.
Which village? I've never heard of any mountain village.

c.speaker: reiner
c.text: We're soldiers now. Whatever happened back home, we carry it forward.

c2.speaker: reiner
c2.text: ...A small one. You wouldn't know it.

a.speaker: jean
a.text: Tch. Not bad. The top ten get the Military Police. The interior. Real beds. No titans. That's the dream, isn't it?

choices.text: It's your dream. Mine's outside the Walls.
Honestly? Safety sounds good.
The best soldiers going furthest from the titans — doesn't that seem backwards?

b.speaker: marco
b.text: I want to serve the King in the Military Police. Doesn't that sound... noble?

choices.text: It does, Marco.
Just make sure the MP deserve you.

c.speaker: jean
c.text: Marco, you're too honest for your own good.

a.speaker: keith
a.text: The top ten graduates: Mikasa Ackerman. Reiner Braun. Bertholdt Hoover. Annie Leonhart. Eren Yeager. Jean Kirstein. Marco Bott. Connie Springer. Sasha Braus. Krista Lenz.

b.speaker: keith
b.text: {name}. A hair short of the ten. Your file says—

c.speaker: keith
c.text: ...'Doesn't quit.' That will matter more than rank where you're going. You choose your branch after your first posting. Dismissed.

choices.text: Salute: fist over the heart.
Ask him why he left the Survey Corps.

d.speaker: keith
d.text: Because I was ordinary, cadet. Don't let anyone tell you that's a crime. Now get out.

a.speaker: eren
a.text: Five years. Tomorrow we pick our branches, and I'm joining the Survey Corps. Nothing's changed.

b.speaker: sasha
b.text: I stole some meat from the officers' stores! We can split it tonight!

choices.text: Sasha, they'll hang you.
Save me the biggest piece.

a.speaker: dimo_reeves
a.text: Push! Push the cart through! My goods are worth more than all your lives put together!

b.speaker: civilian_f
b.text: Please — the titans are coming, we can't get past!

choices.text: Move that cart, or I move you.
Your goods are worthless if you're eaten, Mr. Reeves. Move it and live.
Everyone! Help me push it through!

c1.speaker: dimo_reeves
c1.text: ...All right! All right! Pull it back!

c2.speaker: dimo_reeves
c2.text: ...Hm. You have a point. PULL BACK!

c3.text: Together, the crowd heaves the cart through the gate.

a.speaker: armin
a.text: {first}... Eren's squad. They're gone. Eren was eaten saving me.

b.speaker: armin
b.text: And then a titan appeared that was killing other titans. It's still out there.

choices.text: Then it's a weapon. We use it.
A titan is a titan, Armin.
Titans don't fight titans. Something's wrong here.

c.speaker: armin
c.text: We can lure it toward the HQ. Mikasa's already out there.

a.speaker: mikasa
a.text: Eren came out of the titan's neck. Alive. They'll call him a monster. They'll try to kill him.

choices.text: Then they'll have to go through me.
Mikasa... maybe they're right to be afraid.
If humans can become titans... then what are titans?

b.speaker: mikasa
b.text: Then stay close. Whatever happens next, stay close.

effects.deed: Saw Eren Yeager emerge from a titan at Trost

a.speaker: erwin
a.text: Trost has been sealed. Eren Yeager's titan carried the boulder. For the first time, humanity has taken ground back from the titans.

b.speaker: erwin
b.text: I won't lie to you. Join the Survey Corps and most of you will be dead within a year. But what we find out there may be the truth of this world.

choices.text: The Survey Corps.
The Garrison. Someone has to hold the Walls.
The Military Police.

d2.speaker: erwin
d2.text: The Walls are in good hands.

d3.speaker: erwin
d3.text: The interior needs honest soldiers. More than you know.
